```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// 🛡️ Global safe transpose function to handle empty databases natively across all panels
safeTranspose = (data) => {
  if (!data) return [];
  if (Array.isArray(data)) return data;
  if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) return [];
  try { return transpose(data) || []; } catch(e) { return []; }
};
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| padding: 0px
//| classes: transparent-card
// ==============================================================================
// SECTION 2.5: GLOBAL DASHBOARD METRICS HERO BANNER
// ==============================================================================
{
  const transposed_stats = safeTranspose(ojs_global_stats);
  if (transposed_stats.length === 0 || !transposed_stats[0].total_ebay_listings) return html`<div style="padding: 20px; color: var(--text-muted); font-style: italic;">Awaiting initial database sync...</div>`;

  const stats = transposed_stats[0];
  const formatNum = (num) => new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US').format(num || 0);
  const updated = stats.last_updated ? new Date(stats.last_updated + "T12:00:00").toLocaleDateString('en-US', { year: 'numeric', month: 'short', day: 'numeric' }) : '—';

  // --- Market-pulse aggregates (computed client-side from live signals & forecasts) ---
  const info = safeTranspose(ojs_info) || [];

  const priceByCard = new Map(info.filter(d => d.current_price).map(d => [d.cardname, d.current_price]));
  const cardsTracked = priceByCard.size;
  const totalListings = stats.total_ebay_listings;

  // Buy / Hold / Sell split — share of rated cards by today's signal call
  const rated = info.filter(d => d.signal_call);
  const tally = { buy: 0, hold: 0, sell: 0 };
  rated.forEach(d => { const c = String(d.signal_call).toLowerCase(); if (tally[c] !== undefined) tally[c]++; });
  const ratedTot = rated.length || 1;
  const pctOf = k => Math.round((tally[k] / ratedTot) * 100);

  // Hype gauge: how eBay asks sit vs each card's OWN normal premium over TCG.
  // anchor_gap is in log units; > +5% = running hot (hype), < -5% = running cold.
  const gaps = info.filter(d => d.anchor_gap != null && isFinite(d.anchor_gap))
                   .map(d => Math.expm1(d.anchor_gap));
  const hypeStats = (() => {
    if (!gaps.length) return null;
    const hot = gaps.filter(g => g > 0.05).length;
    const cold = gaps.filter(g => g < -0.05).length;
    const sorted = [...gaps].sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const med = sorted[Math.floor(sorted.length / 2)];
    return { med, hot, cold, n: gaps.length };
  })();
  const hypeRow = (s) => {
    if (!s) return `<div style="margin-top:8px; font-size:18px; font-weight:800; color:var(--text-muted);">—</div>`;
    const up = s.med >= 0;
    const col = up ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-green)';  // hot asks = froth, not good news
    return `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:baseline; margin-top:8px;">
      <span style="font-size:12px; color:var(--text-muted); font-weight:600;">${s.hot} hot / ${s.cold} cold</span>
      <span style="font-size:20px; font-weight:800; color:${col};">${up ? '▲' : '▼'} ${Math.abs(s.med * 100).toFixed(1)}%</span></div>`;
  };

  const tile = (border, label, valueHTML, subHTML) => `
    <div class="hero-tile" style="border-top-color:${border};">
      <div class="hero-tile-label">${label}</div>
      ${valueHTML}
      ${subHTML || ''}
    </div>`;
  const bigVal = (txt, color) => `<div class="hero-tile-value" style="color:${color || 'var(--text-main)'};">${txt}</div>`;
  const subTxt = (txt) => `<div class="hero-tile-sub">${txt}</div>`;

  const splitBar = `<div style="display:flex; height:10px; border-radius:5px; overflow:hidden; margin-top:12px; margin-bottom:8px;">
      <div style="width:${pctOf('buy')}%; background:var(--accent-green);"></div>
      <div style="width:${pctOf('hold')}%; background:var(--text-muted);"></div>
      <div style="width:${pctOf('sell')}%; background:var(--accent-red);"></div>
    </div>`;
  const splitLegend = `<div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; font-size:12px; font-weight:700;">
      <span style="color:var(--accent-green);">Buy ${pctOf('buy')}%</span>
      <span style="color:var(--text-muted);">Hold ${pctOf('hold')}%</span>
      <span style="color:var(--accent-red);">Sell ${pctOf('sell')}%</span>
    </div>`;

  const outlookBorder = !hypeStats ? 'var(--text-muted)' : (hypeStats.med >= 0 ? 'var(--accent-red)' : 'var(--accent-green)');

  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.width = "100%";
  wrap.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:flex-end; gap:8px; margin-bottom:12px;">
      <span style="width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent-green); box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--accent-green);"></span>
      <span style="font-size:13px; color:var(--text-muted); font-weight:600;">Data updated: <span style="color:var(--text-main);">${updated}</span></span>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-tiles">
      ${tile('var(--accent-blue)', 'Cards Tracked', bigVal(formatNum(cardsTracked)), subTxt('High-rarity cards priced daily'))}
      ${tile('var(--accent-cyan)', 'Total Unique Listings', bigVal(formatNum(totalListings)), subTxt('Distinct eBay listings collected to date'))}
      ${tile('var(--accent-purple)', 'Market Signal', splitBar + splitLegend, subTxt(formatNum(rated.length) + ' cards rated today'))}
      ${tile(outlookBorder, 'eBay Hype Gauge', hypeRow(hypeStats), subTxt('Median gap between eBay asks and each card\'s usual premium — hot asks tend to correct'))}
    </div>`;
  return wrap;
}
```

## Row

### 🔥 Market Movers — 7-Day Trends

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// ==============================================================================
// SECTION 2.6: OBSERVABLE JAVASCRIPT INITIALIZATION & SHARED HELPERS
// ==============================================================================

Plotly = require("plotly.js-dist-min@2.30.0")

// Reconstruct incoming title pairs directly for linear search dictionary
ebay_title_map = {
  const map = new Map();
  if (ojs_ebay_titles && ojs_ebay_titles.item_id && ojs_ebay_titles.listing_title) {
    const ids = Array.from(ojs_ebay_titles.item_id);
    const titles = Array.from(ojs_ebay_titles.listing_title);
    for (let i = 0; i < ids.length; i++) {
      if (ids[i] && titles[i]) map.set(String(ids[i]).trim(), titles[i]);
    }
  }
  return map;
}

// Build a live eBay listing URL straight from the item_id (format: v1|<legacyId>|<var>).
// The id already encodes the listing number, so no stored links / extra table is needed.
ebayItemUrl = (item_id) => {
  if (!item_id) return null;
  const parts = String(item_id).split("|");
  const legacy = parts.length > 1 ? parts[1] : parts[0];
  if (!/^[0-9]+$/.test(legacy)) return null;
  return `https://www.ebay.com/itm/${legacy}`;
}

// Deep-link a card from the Overview tables into the Market Explorer deep dive:
// switch to the Explorer tab, prefill its search (filters to that exact cardname),
// then auto-open the single matching row. Works for both desktop & mobile layouts.
openInExplorer = (name) => {
  if (!name) return;
  const tab = document.getElementById('tab-market-explorer');
  if (tab) tab.click();
  setTimeout(() => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.explorer-search').forEach(inp => {
      inp.value = name;
      inp.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true }));
    });
    setTimeout(() => {
      const pane = document.getElementById('market-explorer');
      const rows = pane ? pane.querySelectorAll('tr.card-row') : [];
      if (rows.length === 1) rows[0].click();
      if (pane) pane.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }, 90);
  }, 130);
}

// Global programmatic data sanitization step for raw listing objects
clean_ebay_master = (safeTranspose(ojs_ebay) || []).map(d => {
  let rawGrade = d.grade_val ? d.grade_val.toString().replace(/['"]/g, '').trim() : "UNG";
  let rawComp = d.grading_company ? d.grading_company.toString().replace(/['"]/g, '').trim() : "UNG";

  if (/^(NA|N\/A|NONE|NULL|UNG|UNGRADED)$/i.test(rawComp)) rawComp = "UNG";
  if (/^(NA|N\/A|NONE|NULL|UNG|UNGRADED)$/i.test(rawGrade)) rawGrade = "UNG";

  let numMatch = rawGrade.match(/\b([1-9](\.[0-9]+)?|10(\.0+)?)\b/);
  let cleanGrade = "UNG";
  if (numMatch && rawGrade !== "UNG") {
    let parsed = parseFloat(numMatch[0]);
    if (parsed > 0 && parsed <= 10) cleanGrade = parsed.toString();
  }

  let cleanCompany = (cleanGrade === "UNG" || rawComp === "UNG") ? "UNG" : rawComp;
  if (cleanCompany === "UNG") cleanGrade = "UNG";

  let label = cleanCompany === 'UNG' ? 'Ungraded' : `${cleanCompany} ${cleanGrade}`;
  let lang = d.card_language ? d.card_language : "English";

  // Auction listings (listing_type contains "AUCTION") are counted toward supply/volume
  // but excluded from all price/median math — auction current-bids are not clean price signal.
  let is_auction = /AUCTION/i.test(d.listing_type || "");

  return {
    ...d, grade_val: cleanGrade, grading_company: cleanCompany, clean_price: +d.price_val, card_language: lang,
    label: label, is_auction: is_auction, hover_text: `<b>${d.cardname}</b><br>${label}<br>$${d.price_val}<br>Date: ${d.date_pulled}`
  };
}).filter(d => !isNaN(d.clean_price) && d.clean_price > 0 && !(d.grading_company === "PSA" && String(d.grade_val).includes(".")));

// Navbar menu badge: today's Buy/Hold/Sell model confidence, always visible.
// Clicking it jumps to the Market Explorer, which carries the full health readout.
{
  const m = (safeTranspose(ojs_signal_metrics) || [])[0];
  const nav = document.querySelector('.navbar #dashboard-collapse');
  const old = document.getElementById('nav-model-conf');
  if (old) old.remove();
  if (!m || m.avg_confidence == null || !nav) return;
  const conf = Math.round(m.avg_confidence * 100);
  const tone = m.avg_confidence >= 0.60 ? ['var(--pos)', 'Confident']
             : m.avg_confidence >= 0.45 ? ['var(--accent-yellow)', 'Moderate']
             : ['var(--neg)', 'Cautious'];
  const badge = document.createElement('a');
  badge.id = 'nav-model-conf';
  badge.className = 'nav-conf-badge';
  badge.href = '#market-explorer';
  badge.title = `Buy/Hold/Sell model — average confidence today ${conf}% (${tone[1].toLowerCase()}) · reliability AUC ${Number(m.auc).toFixed(2)} · ${m.horizon}-day outlook. Click for the full model health readout in the Market Explorer.`;
  badge.innerHTML = `<span class="nav-conf-dot" style="background:${tone[0]}; box-shadow:0 0 6px ${tone[0]};"></span><span class="nav-conf-text">Model confidence: <b style="color:${tone[0]};">${conf}% · ${tone[1]}</b></span>`;
  badge.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const t = document.getElementById('tab-market-explorer');
    if (t) t.click();
  });
  nav.appendChild(badge);
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// ==============================================================================
// SECTION 2.6.5: 7-DAY MARKET MOVERS — paired tables (TCGplayer & eBay medians)
// with inline sparklines; rows deep-link into the Market Explorer.
// ==============================================================================
{
  const DAY = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
  const all_hist = (safeTranspose(ojs_hist) || []).map(d => ({ ...d, date: new Date(d.date + "T12:00:00") }));
  const infoMap = new Map((safeTranspose(ojs_info) || []).map(d => [d.cardname, d]));

  // Inline SVG sparkline: single series, colored by 7-day direction (▲/▼ + signed
  // numbers in the same row carry the direction too, so color is never alone).
  const spark = (vals, color) => {
    if (!vals || vals.length < 2) return `<span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:11px;">—</span>`;
    const w = 88, h = 30, p = 4;
    const min = Math.min(...vals), max = Math.max(...vals);
    const span = (max - min) || 1;
    const pts = vals.map((v, i) => [
      (p + (i / (vals.length - 1)) * (w - 2 * p)).toFixed(1),
      (h - p - ((v - min) / span) * (h - 2 * p)).toFixed(1)
    ]);
    const last = pts[pts.length - 1];
    return `<svg width="${w}" height="${h}" viewBox="0 0 ${w} ${h}" style="display:block; overflow:visible;" aria-hidden="true">
      <polyline points="${pts.map(pt => pt.join(',')).join(' ')}" fill="none" stroke="${color}" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" opacity="0.9"/>
      <circle cx="${last[0]}" cy="${last[1]}" r="2.5" fill="${color}"/>
    </svg>`;
  };

  // --- TCGplayer (JustTCG) movers: latest market price vs the record ~7 days back ---
  const histByCard = new Map();
  all_hist.forEach(d => {
    if (d.price == null) return;
    if (!histByCard.has(d.cardname)) histByCard.set(d.cardname, []);
    histByCard.get(d.cardname).push(d);
  });
  const tcgMovers = [];
  histByCard.forEach((rows, name) => {
    rows.sort((a, b) => a.date - b.date);
    const cur = rows[rows.length - 1];
    const target = cur.date.getTime() - 7 * DAY;
    let base = null;
    rows.forEach(r => { if (!base || Math.abs(r.date.getTime() - target) < Math.abs(base.date.getTime() - target)) base = r; });
    // Need a baseline within ±2 days of "7 days ago" and a sane starting price.
    if (!base || base === cur || Math.abs(base.date.getTime() - target) > 2 * DAY || base.price < 1) return;
    const series = rows.filter(r => r.date.getTime() >= target).map(r => r.price);
    tcgMovers.push({ name, cur: cur.price, abs: cur.price - base.price, pct: (cur.price - base.price) / base.price * 100, series });
  });

  // --- eBay ungraded median movers: daily medians (auction-free), same 7-day window ---
  const listings = (clean_ebay_master || []).filter(d => d.label === "Ungraded" && !d.is_auction);
  const medByCard = new Map();
  listings.forEach(d => {
    if (!medByCard.has(d.cardname)) medByCard.set(d.cardname, new Map());
    const days = medByCard.get(d.cardname);
    if (!days.has(d.date_pulled)) days.set(d.date_pulled, []);
    days.get(d.date_pulled).push(d.clean_price);
  });
  const median = arr => { const p = [...arr].sort((a, b) => a - b); const m = Math.floor(p.length / 2); return p.length % 2 ? p[m] : (p[m - 1] + p[m]) / 2; };
  const globalLatestMs = listings.length ? Math.max(...[...new Set(listings.map(d => d.date_pulled))].map(s => new Date(s + "T12:00:00").getTime())) : 0;
  const ebayMovers = [];
  medByCard.forEach((days, name) => {
    // Only days with >=2 listings count — a single listing is not a median.
    const meds = [...days.entries()].filter(([, v]) => v.length >= 2)
      .map(([date, v]) => ({ ms: new Date(date + "T12:00:00").getTime(), med: median(v), n: v.length }))
      .sort((a, b) => a.ms - b.ms);
    if (meds.length < 2) return;
    const cur = meds[meds.length - 1];
    if (globalLatestMs - cur.ms > 2 * DAY) return; // card has gone stale
    const target = cur.ms - 7 * DAY;
    let base = null;
    meds.forEach(r => { if (!base || Math.abs(r.ms - target) < Math.abs(base.ms - target)) base = r; });
    if (!base || base === cur || Math.abs(base.ms - target) > 2 * DAY || base.med < 1) return;
    const series = meds.filter(r => r.ms >= target).map(r => r.med);
    ebayMovers.push({ name, cur: cur.med, abs: cur.med - base.med, pct: (cur.med - base.med) / base.med * 100, series, n: cur.n, nBase: base.n });
  });

  // --- Shared table builder: top 5 gainers + top 5 losers per source ---
  const escAttr = s => String(s).replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
  const money = v => '$' + Number(v).toFixed(2);
  const moverRow = (d) => {
    const up = d.pct >= 0;
    const col = up ? 'var(--pos)' : 'var(--neg)';
    const info = infoMap.get(d.name);
    const tip = d.n != null
      ? `Median of ${d.n} listing${d.n === 1 ? '' : 's'} today vs ${d.nBase} ~7 days ago · Open in Market Explorer →`
      : 'Open in Market Explorer →';
    return `<tr class="mover-row" data-cardname="${escAttr(d.name)}" title="${tip}">
      <td class="mv-card"><div><img src="${info ? info.image_path : ''}" loading="lazy" onerror="this.style.display='none'"><span>${d.name}</span></div></td>
      <td class="mv-price">${money(d.cur)}</td>
      <td class="mv-delta" style="color:${col};">${up ? '▲' : '▼'} ${up ? '+' : '−'}$${Math.abs(d.abs).toFixed(2)}<span class="mv-pct">${up ? '+' : ''}${d.pct.toFixed(1)}%</span></td>
      <td class="mv-trend">${spark(d.series, col)}</td>
    </tr>`;
  };
  const groupHeader = (label, col) => `<tr class="mv-group"><td colspan="4" style="color:${col};">${label}</td></tr>`;
  const emptyRow = `<tr><td colspan="4" class="mv-empty">No movement in this window.</td></tr>`;
  const buildPanel = (sub, movers) => {
    const gainers = movers.filter(m => m.pct > 0).sort((a, b) => b.pct - a.pct).slice(0, 5);
    const losers = movers.filter(m => m.pct < 0).sort((a, b) => a.pct - b.pct).slice(0, 5);
    return `<div class="movers-panel">
      <div class="movers-panel-sub" style="margin-bottom:10px;">${sub}</div>
      <table class="movers-table">
        <thead><tr><th>Card</th><th style="text-align:right;">Price</th><th style="text-align:right;">7D Change</th><th>Trend</th></tr></thead>
        <tbody>
          ${groupHeader('▲ Top gainers', 'var(--pos)')}
          ${gainers.map(moverRow).join('') || emptyRow}
          ${groupHeader('▼ Top losers', 'var(--neg)')}
          ${losers.map(moverRow).join('') || emptyRow}
        </tbody>
      </table>
    </div>`;
  };

  if (tcgMovers.length === 0 && ebayMovers.length === 0) {
    return html`<div style="padding:20px; color:var(--text-muted); font-style:italic;">Awaiting price history — movers appear once a 7-day baseline exists.</div>`;
  }

  // Tabbed view: flip between the two sources in place instead of scrolling past both.
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.width = "100%";
  wrap.innerHTML = `
    <div class="seg-tabs">
      <button class="seg-tab active" data-target="tcg">🎴 TCGplayer Price</button>
      <button class="seg-tab" data-target="ebay">🛒 eBay Ungraded Median</button>
    </div>
    <div class="seg-pane" data-pane="tcg">${buildPanel('JustTCG daily market price · change vs ~7 days ago', tcgMovers)}</div>
    <div class="seg-pane" data-pane="ebay" style="display:none;">${buildPanel('Daily median of ungraded fixed-price listings (auctions excluded) · hover a row for listing counts', ebayMovers)}</div>`;
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.seg-tab').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    wrap.querySelectorAll('.seg-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn));
    wrap.querySelectorAll('.seg-pane').forEach(p => { p.style.display = p.dataset.pane === btn.dataset.target ? '' : 'none'; });
  }));
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.mover-row').forEach(row => row.addEventListener('click', () => openInExplorer(row.dataset.cardname)));
  return wrap;
}
```

## Row

### 💰 Daily Signals — Top Buys & Sells (by rarity)

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// ==============================================================================
// SECTION 2.5.5: TOP BUY / SELL SIGNAL TABLES — split by rarity, deep-linked
// ==============================================================================
{
  const info = safeTranspose(ojs_info) || [];
  const rated = info.filter(d => d.p_buy != null && d.current_price);

  // Rarity buckets: Enchanted + Iconic grouped together; Epic on its own.
  const isEnchIconic = d => { const r = String(d.rarity || '').toLowerCase(); return r === 'enchanted' || r === 'iconic'; };
  const isEpic = d => String(d.rarity || '').toLowerCase() === 'epic';
  const escAttr = s => String(s).replace(/"/g, '&quot;');

  const money = v => v != null ? '$' + Number(v).toFixed(2) : 'N/A';
  const pctBadge = (v, color) => `<span style="color:${color}; font-weight:800;">${Math.round(v * 100)}%</span>`;

  const buildTable = (subtitle, rows, probKey, probColor) => {
    const body = rows.map((d, i) => `
      <tr class="ov-card-row" data-cardname="${escAttr(d.cardname)}" style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle); cursor:pointer;" title="Open in Market Explorer →">
        <td style="padding:9px 8px; color:var(--text-muted); font-weight:700; width:26px;">${i + 1}</td>
        <td style="padding:9px 8px;">
          <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;">
            <img src="${d.image_path}" loading="lazy" style="height:38px; border-radius:4px; flex-shrink:0;" onerror="this.style.display='none'">
            <span style="color:var(--text-main); font-size:13px; line-height:1.3;">${d.cardname} <span style="color:var(--accent-blue); font-size:11px;">↗</span></span>
          </div>
        </td>
        <td style="padding:9px 8px; text-align:right; color:var(--accent-yellow); font-weight:700; white-space:nowrap;">${money(d.current_price)}</td>
        <td style="padding:9px 8px; text-align:right; white-space:nowrap;">${pctBadge(d[probKey], probColor)}</td>
      </tr>`).join('');
    return `
      <div style="flex:1; min-width:min(320px, 100%); background:var(--bg-card); border-radius:12px; padding:18px; box-shadow:0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);">
        <div style="margin:0 0 12px 0; color:var(--text-muted); font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.5px; font-weight:700;">${subtitle}</div>
        <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:13px;">
          <thead><tr style="border-bottom:2px solid var(--border-subtle);">
            <th style="padding:6px 8px; color:var(--text-muted); font-size:11px; text-transform:uppercase; text-align:left;">#</th>
            <th style="padding:6px 8px; color:var(--text-muted); font-size:11px; text-transform:uppercase; text-align:left;">Card</th>
            <th style="padding:6px 8px; color:var(--text-muted); font-size:11px; text-transform:uppercase; text-align:right;">Price</th>
            <th style="padding:6px 8px; color:var(--text-muted); font-size:11px; text-transform:uppercase; text-align:right;">Prob</th>
          </tr></thead>
          <tbody>${body || `<tr><td colspan="4" style="padding:14px; color:var(--text-muted); font-style:italic;">No rated cards.</td></tr>`}</tbody>
        </table>
      </div>`;
  };

  const topN = (pred, key) => [...rated].filter(pred).sort((a, b) => b[key] - a[key]).slice(0, 8);

  const groupHtml = (accent, probKey) => `
    <div style="display:flex; gap:20px; flex-wrap:wrap; width:100%;">
      ${buildTable('Enchanted &amp; Iconic', topN(isEnchIconic, probKey), probKey, accent)}
      ${buildTable('Epic', topN(isEpic, probKey), probKey, accent)}
    </div>`;

  // Tabbed view: flip between Buys and Sells in place instead of scrolling past both.
  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.width = "100%";
  wrap.innerHTML = `
    <div class="seg-tabs">
      <button class="seg-tab active" data-target="buy">🟢 Top Buys</button>
      <button class="seg-tab" data-target="sell">🔴 Top Sells</button>
    </div>
    <div class="seg-pane" data-pane="buy">${groupHtml('var(--accent-green)', 'p_buy')}</div>
    <div class="seg-pane" data-pane="sell" style="display:none;">${groupHtml('var(--accent-red)', 'p_sell')}</div>`;
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.seg-tab').forEach(btn => btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    wrap.querySelectorAll('.seg-tab').forEach(b => b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn));
    wrap.querySelectorAll('.seg-pane').forEach(p => { p.style.display = p.dataset.pane === btn.dataset.target ? '' : 'none'; });
  }));

  // Whole-row deep link into the Market Explorer, plus hover affordance.
  wrap.querySelectorAll('.ov-card-row').forEach(row => {
    row.addEventListener('click', () => openInExplorer(row.dataset.cardname));
    row.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => { row.style.background = 'var(--bg-base)'; });
    row.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => { row.style.background = 'transparent'; });
  });
  return wrap;
}
```

## Row

### 📦 Supply Highlights (unique active listings)

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// ==============================================================================
// SECTION 2.5.6: SUPPLY HIGHLIGHTS — listing-count movers & extremes
// ==============================================================================
{
  const listings = clean_ebay_master || [];
  if (listings.length === 0) return html`<div style="padding:20px; color:var(--text-muted); font-style:italic;">Awaiting listing data...</div>`;

  const dates = [...new Set(listings.map(d => d.date_pulled))].sort();
  const latest = dates[dates.length - 1];
  const latestMs = new Date(latest).getTime();
  // Baseline = the most recent pull that is at least 7 days before the latest pull.
  let baseline = null;
  for (let i = dates.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    if (new Date(dates[i]).getTime() <= latestMs - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) { baseline = dates[i]; break; }
  }

  const uniqOn = (date) => {
    const m = new Map();
    listings.filter(d => d.date_pulled === date).forEach(d => {
      if (!m.has(d.cardname)) m.set(d.cardname, new Set());
      m.get(d.cardname).add(d.item_id);
    });
    const out = new Map();
    m.forEach((s, k) => out.set(k, s.size));
    return out;
  };
  const todayCounts = uniqOn(latest);
  const baseCounts = baseline ? uniqOn(baseline) : new Map();

  const infoMap = new Map((safeTranspose(ojs_info) || []).map(d => [d.cardname, d]));
  const imgFor = (name) => { const d = infoMap.get(name); return d ? d.image_path : ''; };

  let changes = [];
  if (baseline) {
    todayCounts.forEach((cnt, name) => {
      const base = baseCounts.get(name) || 0;
      changes.push({ name, delta: cnt - base, cnt, base });
    });
  }
  const maxInc = changes.filter(c => c.delta > 0).sort((a, b) => b.delta - a.delta)[0] || null;
  const maxDec = changes.filter(c => c.delta < 0).sort((a, b) => a.delta - b.delta)[0] || null;

  const counts = [...todayCounts.entries()].map(([name, cnt]) => ({ name, cnt })).filter(c => c.cnt > 0);
  const rarest = counts.slice().sort((a, b) => a.cnt - b.cnt)[0] || null;
  const common = counts.slice().sort((a, b) => b.cnt - a.cnt)[0] || null;

  const num = (n, color) => `<span style="color:${color || 'var(--text-main)'}; font-weight:800; font-size:15px;">${n}</span>`;
  const row = (icon, label, item, valueHTML, accent) => {
    if (!item) return `<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle);"><td style="padding:11px 8px; white-space:nowrap;">${icon} <span style="color:${accent}; font-weight:700; font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase;">${label}</span></td><td colspan="2" style="padding:11px 8px; color:var(--text-muted); font-style:italic;">Insufficient history</td></tr>`;
    return `<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-subtle);">
      <td style="padding:11px 8px; white-space:nowrap;">${icon} <span style="color:${accent}; font-weight:700; font-size:12px; text-transform:uppercase;">${label}</span></td>
      <td style="padding:11px 8px;"><div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px;"><img src="${imgFor(item.name)}" loading="lazy" style="height:36px; border-radius:4px; flex-shrink:0;" onerror="this.style.display='none'"><span style="color:var(--text-main); font-size:13px;">${item.name}</span></div></td>
      <td style="padding:11px 8px; text-align:right; white-space:nowrap;">${valueHTML}</td>
    </tr>`;
  };

  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
  wrap.style.cssText = "width:100%; background:var(--bg-card); border-radius:12px; padding:18px; box-shadow:0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);";
  wrap.innerHTML = `
    <table style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse;">
      <tbody>
        ${row('📈', 'Biggest Supply Increase', maxInc, maxInc ? num('+' + maxInc.delta, 'var(--accent-green)') + `<span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:11px;"> (${maxInc.base}→${maxInc.cnt})</span>` : '', 'var(--accent-green)')}
        ${row('📉', 'Biggest Supply Decrease', maxDec, maxDec ? num(maxDec.delta, 'var(--accent-red)') + `<span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:11px;"> (${maxDec.base}→${maxDec.cnt})</span>` : '', 'var(--accent-red)')}
        ${row('💎', 'Rarest (fewest listings)', rarest, rarest ? num(rarest.cnt) + `<span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:11px;"> listings</span>` : '', 'var(--accent-blue)')}
        ${row('🌊', 'Most Common (most listings)', common, common ? num(common.cnt) + `<span style="color:var(--text-muted); font-size:11px;"> listings</span>` : '', 'var(--accent-cyan)')}
      </tbody>
    </table>
    <div style="font-size:11px; color:var(--text-muted); margin-top:10px; font-style:italic;">Supply change compares today's pull (${latest})${baseline ? ' vs ' + baseline : ' — awaiting 7-day baseline'}. Counts are unique active listings per card.</div>`;
  return wrap;
}
```
